_note: Interior decorators are real players. You send any of them a request with a budget (and their fee, both held); they accept, walk into your home, buy from the store with your budget and arrange things, and you see it when they finish. Each studio is an optional style brief. budget and abandonHours are mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_decor_house_calls.sql; the career, fee limits and interview in *_decorators.sql (scripts/check-life-config.mjs). minutes, touches and each studio's decorator only serve jobs from before this.

studios.title: Modern Arabic
studios.blurb: Travertine floors, warm greige walls with panelling, a low majlis, calligraphy and a date palm.

studios.title: Marble Luxe
studios.blurb: Calacatta marble, ivory panelled walls, a crystal chandelier, velvet, gold and fresh orchids.

studios.title: Calm Scandi
studios.blurb: Light oak, sage walls, a lounge chair by the lamp, open shelves, plants and pampas.

studios.title: Midnight Lounge
studios.blurb: Black marble, midnight-navy panelled walls, smoked glass pendants, brass sconces and the desert at dusk.

interview.q: A client wants their small studio to feel bigger. You…
options: Fill it with dark, heavy furniture
Use light colours, mirrors and fewer, well-placed pieces
Paint every wall a different colour

interview.q: A client's budget is AED 10,000 but they love a AED 38,000 piano. You…
options: Show options that fit the budget and explain the trade-offs

interview.q: You're handed the client's key. You…
options: Use it only for the job and give it back when you're done
